archetypes.name: stream-parity
archetypes.rationale: The migration introduces asymmetric stdout/stderr routing rules across six verbs (upsert-summary failures go to stderr; other verb failures go to stdout; read shell-level usage goes to stdout but parser-level missing-option-values stay stderr-only), and any divergence silently breaks shell consumers that parse specific streams.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the new Python tracking-issue CLI in python/tracking_issue.py and python/cli.py for stdout/stderr stream routing correctness across all six verbs (read, create-issue, append-comment, rename, mark-false-positive, upsert-summary). Verify that upsert-summary non-usage failures land on stderr while all other verb non-usage failures land on stdout, that read shell-level usage failures emit FAILED=true and ERROR=usage:... on stdout with empty stderr, that parser-level missing-option-value cases emit stderr-only diagnostics with no stdout envelope, and that write-verb usage errors never emit a stdout failure envelope. Check whether quiet_init is called before any contract output in each main, and whether quiet routing could accidentally reroute KEY=value stdout under inherited quiet environments. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: migration-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The migration deletes twelve shell helpers and their harnesses while cutting over every consumer; any missed reference in scripts/, skills/, docs/, Makefile, AGENTS.md, SECURITY.md, agent-lint.toml, or .gitleaks.toml is a runtime breakage that may not be caught by tests if the calling script conditionally invokes the helper.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the diff for migration completeness: verify that scripts/implement-bootstrap.sh, skills/implement/scripts/step-0-bootstrap.sh, scripts/implement-finalize.sh, scripts/ship-pr.sh, skills/design/SKILL.md, skills/design/scripts/design-init-runparams.sh, skills/design/scripts/design-publish.sh, skills/design/scripts/render-final-summary.sh, skills/implement/scripts/post-tracking-issue.sh, skills/implement/scripts/refresh-execution-issues.sh, and skills/implement/scripts/write-final-report.sh all invoke the Python CLI rather than the retired shell helpers. Check agent-lint.toml to confirm all retired-helper exclusion entries are removed and no new stale entries were introduced. Verify the Makefile .PHONY list and shard assignments no longer reference test-tracking-issue-write, test-tracking-issue-summary, or test-tracking-issue-read-sentinel. Look for any surviving bare tracking-issue-read, tracking-issue-write, or tracking-issue-summary tokens in the diff hunks that are not within python/migrated-scripts.tsv or the .gitleaks.toml allowlist description. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
